*** RE-POINTED 2026-08-22.  relevel_lane_snap no longer drives the seed-site snap
this file was originally written for -- that mechanism was DELETED as a proven exact
solve no-op (7.2) and its 'snapped' counter no longer exists.  The knob now arms the
CARRY-DOMAIN lane observatory, which is MEASURE-ONLY. ***
Consequence for this arm's design: it is BYTE-IDENTICAL to the control
_fld63_relevel4h_ctlw on every solve artifact, so it is no longer an A/B -- it is a
single measurement that carries its own wiring check.
PRE-REGISTERED: (1) n_lane_measured nonzero and BOTH closure identities OK in the
run-end 'lane observatory v3' line -- 0 attempts on this slip-bearing posture is dead
wiring, not a null (invariant #4); (2) the |delta| histogram mass sits BELOW ~2 cyc
(the carry-frame prediction; residual eps_L(t+)-eps_L(t-)-eps_MW, with eps_MW ~0.351
cyc on the DUAL WL(1,2) chain this config runs) -- mass in the >=10/>=25 bins
reproduces the deleted seed site's own signature and FALSIFIES the carry-domain
diagnosis, in which case no apply leg gets built; (3) scripts/field_lane_frac.py must
return IDENTICAL numbers on this arm and on the control -- any difference is a bug in
the observatory, not an effect, because nothing is written back.
